India loses Lord's ODI series after late collapse

The Indian cricket team lost the Lord's ODI series against England 1-2 after a late collapse in the final overs. Captain Shubman Gill identified poor bowling in the powerplay and conceding around 60 runs in the last three overs as key reasons for the defeat. The team had been in a strong position until the 45th over.
